name: BDM
tagline: Business Documents Management: e-documents signed, rejected and tracked from an iPhone
role: Mobile app built by our founder, published by THE MIND

scenes.title: E-documents with legal force
scenes.body: Sign in with E-IMZO or a web login to BDM, an official electronic document operator in Uzbekistan.

scenes.title: Sign, reject or download
scenes.body: Invoice cards show number, date, amount and counterparty; push alerts flag new documents to sign.

scenes.title: Inbox and outbox, folder by folder
scenes.body: A drawer splits received, signed, rejected and uploaded documents with counts, and a filter speeds up search.

scenes.title: Balance and tariffs in the cabinet
scenes.body: Check the balance and switch between a per-document tariff and a monthly plan; documents are kept 5 years.
